title: Same-Day Tour Package (Historic Cave Tour & Saint Paul Gangster Tour)
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: All sales are final. No refund is available for cancellations.
blurb:
The package tour will give you priority seating on the bus portion of the tour, as well as a VIP photo opportunity with a 1930 Hudson Essex Gangster Car. 
Please note: even though this tour is year-round, the Hudson Essex is a seasonal offering.
